require 'faye/websocket'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'digest'
require 'openssl'

module BlockchainNode
  class ContractEngine
    FEATURE_FLAGS = {
      enable_delegated_execution: true,
      require_origin_verification: true,
      allow_cross_chain_relay: true,
      strict_session_binding: true
    }.freeze

    # Server-side secret used to key HMAC-based verification. Must be provided
    # via a secure source (env/secret manager) and never derived from
    # client-controlled data.
    SERVER_SECRET = ENV.fetch('CONTRACT_ENGINE_SECRET') { SecureRandom.hex(32) }.freeze

    attr_reader :sessions, :pending_txns, :contract_state

    def initialize
      @sessions = {}
      @pending_txns = []
      @contract_state = {}
      @nonce_registry = {}
    end

    def handle_websocket_open(ws, env)
      session_id = SecureRandom.hex(32)
      origin = env['HTTP_ORIGIN']
      peer_addr = env['REMOTE_ADDR']

      session = {
        id: session_id,
        ws: ws,
        origin: origin,
        peer_addr: peer_addr,
        authenticated: false,
        auth_token: nil,
        bound_address: nil,
        created_at: Time.now.to_i
      }

      @sessions[session_id] = session
      ws.send(JSON.generate({ type: 'session_init', session_id: session_id }))
    end

    def handle_message(ws, raw_msg)
      msg = JSON.parse(raw_msg)
      session = find_session_by_ws(ws)
      return unless session

      case msg['action']
      when 'authenticate'
        process_authentication(session, msg)
      when 'submit_transaction'
        process_transaction(session, msg)
      when 'delegate_execution'
        process_delegation(session, msg)
      when 'query_state'
        process_query(session, msg)
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      ws.send(JSON.generate({ error: 'invalid_json' }))
    end

    private

    def find_session_by_ws(ws)
      @sessions.values.find { |s| s[:ws] == ws }
    end

    def process_authentication(session, msg)
      token = msg['token']
      address = msg['address']
      signature = msg['signature']

      return send_error(session, 'missing_params') unless token && address && signature

      if verify_signature(address, token, signature)
        session[:authenticated] = true
        session[:auth_token] = token
        session[:bound_address] = address
        send_success(session, 'authenticated')
      else
        send_error(session, 'auth_failed')
      end
    end

    def process_transaction(session, msg)
      unless session[:authenticated]
        return send_error(session, 'not_authenticated')
      end

      txn = {
        from: session[:bound_address],
        to: msg['to'],
        value: msg['value'].to_i,
        data: msg['data'],
        nonce: generate_nonce(session[:bound_address]),
        timestamp: Time.now.to_i
      }

      if validate_transaction(txn)
        @pending_txns << txn
        execute_contract(txn)
        send_success(session, 'txn_submitted', { txn_hash: hash_txn(txn) })
      else
        send_error(session, 'invalid_transaction')
      end
    end

    def process_delegation(session, msg)
      unless FEATURE_FLAGS[:enable_delegated_execution]
        return send_error(session, 'delegation_disabled')
      end

      unless session[:authenticated]
        return send_error(session, 'not_authenticated')
      end

      delegate_session_id = msg['delegate_to']
      delegate_session = @sessions[delegate_session_id]

      unless delegate_session
        return send_error(session, 'delegate_not_found')
      end

      if verify_delegation_authority(session, delegate_session, msg)
        transfer_execution_context(session, delegate_session)
        send_success(session, 'delegation_complete')
      else
        send_error(session, 'delegation_unauthorized')
      end
    end

    def verify_delegation_authority(source, target, msg)
      return false unless source[:authenticated]

      if FEATURE_FLAGS[:require_origin_verification]
        return false unless check_origin_policy(source, target)
      end

      if FEATURE_FLAGS[:strict_session_binding]
        return false unless target[:authenticated]
        return false unless target[:bound_address] == msg['expected_delegate']
      end

      delegation_token = msg['delegation_token']
      verify_delegation_token(source[:bound_address], delegation_token)
    end

    def check_origin_policy(source, target)
      source[:origin] == target[:origin]
    end

    def transfer_execution_context(source, target)
      target[:bound_address] = source[:bound_address]
      target[:authenticated] = true
      target[:auth_token] = source[:auth_token]
      target[:delegated_from] = source[:id]
    end

    def verify_delegation_token(address, token)
      return false unless token
      expected = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', SERVER_SECRET, "delegate:#{address}:#{Time.now.to_i / 300}")
      secure_compare(expected, token)
    end

    def verify_signature(address, token, signature)
      expected = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', SERVER_SECRET, "#{address}:#{token}")
      secure_compare(expected, signature)
    end

    def validate_transaction(txn)
      txn[:from] && txn[:to] && txn[:value] >= 0
    end

    def execute_contract(txn)
      key = "balance:#{txn[:from]}"
      current = @contract_state[key] || 1000
      @contract_state[key] = current - txn[:value]
      dest_key = "balance:#{txn[:to]}"
      @contract_state[dest_key] = (@contract_state[dest_key] || 0) + txn[:value]
    end

    def generate_nonce(address)
      @nonce_registry[address] ||= 0
      @nonce_registry[address] += 1
    end

    def hash_txn(txn)
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(txn.to_s)
    end

    def send_success(session, msg, extra = {})
      session[:ws].send(JSON.generate({ status: 'ok', message: msg }.merge(extra)))
    end

    def send_error(session, msg)
      session[:ws].send(JSON.generate({ status: 'error', message: msg }))
    end

    def secure_compare(a, b)
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      l = a.unpack('C*')
      r = b.unpack('C*')
      result = 0
      l.zip(r) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
      result == 0
    end
  end
end
